title: Domino run
description: 1 474 dominoes on a walnut floor, running through S-bends, three forks and twin spirals. Tap one to start the wave. Each strike kicks up a little dust, and ambient occlusion darkens the gaps where they crowd together. In the portrait layout, a picture painted on their backs in sixteen colours appears as they fall. It's a sunset by default, or drop in your own image. The Domino run tutorial builds this scene.
line: 1 474 dominoes in late sun. Tap one and the wave runs.
hint: tap a domino to topple it · drop an image for a portrait · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
